text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While public interest in 'Project L'Arc' 
began to spread, their expectations were 
not yet grounded in a true belief of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Umamusume participating in 
the project devote themselves diligently 
to training aimed at the "Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just the Umamusume working hard. 
The Trainer also continued to put in 
relentless effort to support them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is 
no easy feat— Even so, aiming for the top 
of the world, each of them took steady 
steps forward, one by one.
